exposure: total urinary arsenic concentrations in the 2nd and 3rd trimester
outcome: newborn birth size (birth weight, head circumference, length, ponderal index)
physical growth of infants within one year after birth (weight and length at 6 and 12 months)
cohort: A prospective cohort study of 1100 pregnant women conducted at the Wuxi Maternity and Child Health Care Hospital, with follow-up of their infants.
finding: Urinary arsenic concentration in the 3rd trimester was associated with an increased incidence of SGA and negatively affected the weight and length of boys at 6 and 12 months of age.
